summary: Completed backend+frontend validation for 8004scan original icon proxy/caching/privacy changes on public preview. Added dedicated icon-proxy regression tests and reran full backend suite.

integration_issues.issue: Build succeeds but emits extensive third-party source-map warnings plus '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage' resolution warning from wallet SDK dependency tree.

action_items: Optional: align scan_agent_icons uniqueness strategy with product claim if historical source-hash versions must coexist (current index is unique by chain_id+token_id only).
Optional: reduce wallet dependency source-map and optional module warnings for cleaner CI/build output.
critical_code_review_comments: Current icon cache index and upsert key are unique on (chain_id, token_id), while retrieval key includes source_hash; this can overwrite prior source versions and may diverge from 'unique by chain+token+source hash' intent.
Security gate implementation in icon_proxy correctly blocks non-HTTPS/local/private/link-local/reserved/multicast sources before outbound fetch; added unit tests now enforce this behavior.
test_credentials: Checked memory/test_credentials.md before auth-related testing; file exists but has no credentials.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: <preview-deployment-url>. Full backend regression now 47 passed. New icon tests cover: mainnet source icon 200 + bytes + X-Agent-Icon-Source=8004scan, fallback SVG path, invalid network 400, public response privacy, repeat GET cache stability, and unit-level rejection of unsafe URL classes without outbound request. Frontend verified marketplace/compare/detail deterministic SVG avatars and onchain mainnet/testnet icon URLs strictly using local /api/onchain/agents/{network}/{token}/icon with mixed source+fallback rendering and no websocket/mixed-content/CORS console noise during tested flows.
rca of the issue: No functional blocker reproduced in icon proxy flow. One initial UI check false-failed due lazy-loaded image naturalWidth=0 before load completion; after adjusting validation to treat !img.complete as pending (not broken), no broken-image issue remained. Build warning noise originates from third-party wallet dependency sourcemaps/optional modules, not from app icon-proxy logic.
